email.name: Phishing or Social Engineering Indicators
email.description: Email subject or content matches known high-risk social engineering keywords.

email.name: Suspicious Sender Domain or Auth Failure
email.description: Sender domain is suspicious, lookalike, or failed SPF/DKIM/DMARC validation.

email.name: High-Risk Weaponized Attachment
email.description: Email contains executable, script, or macro-enabled document attachment.

auth.name: Repeated Failed Login Attempts (Brute Force / Password Spray)
auth.description: Multiple authentication failures detected within a short time window.

auth.name: Impossible Travel or Unusual Geolocation
auth.description: Authentication event from geographically incongruent or high-risk source location.

auth.name: MFA Fatigue / Repeated Push Denials Followed by Success
auth.description: Series of MFA push rejections immediately followed by a successful authentication.

auth.name: Privilege Escalation / Admin Account Abuse
auth.description: Privileged role or service account accessed unexpectedly or without change ticket.

network.name: Outbound Connection to Known Malicious / C2 Port
network.description: Outbound network traffic destined for common command-and-control ports.

network.name: Unusual High-Volume Outbound Data Transfer
network.description: Significant volume of data exfiltrated to external destination in single session.

network.name: C2 Periodic Beaconing Pattern
network.description: Regular interval connections with minimal payload to external IP/domain.
